league.name: East Texas Basketball League
league.demo_note: These teams, gyms and results are placeholders so the league can see how the site works before the 2026-27 divisions are final. Real teams and scores replace them before tip-off.

billing.notes: New build Sept 2026 for BJ Threlkeld (Mineola, TX). Youth developmental basketball, ~3rd-6th grade, 96 teams / 6 divisions / 7 towns, one commissioner per town. Every team, division, town, gym and result is a PLACEHOLDER (demo:true) until the league sends real data. Branding is a placeholder navy / burnt-orange theme with a generated logo — see data/etbl/README.md for the swap.

league.about: Developmental youth basketball for 3rd through 6th graders across seven East Texas towns, based in Mineola. Six divisions, one commissioner per town, and Saturday games in local gyms — a league built to get kids ready for middle-school ball, not to chase rings.

_notes.read_me: data/etbl/README.md — what is real, what is placeholder, and the local bring-up.
_notes.admin_password: The shared admin password is NOT stored here. Set env ETBL_ADMIN_PASSWORD (local shell / Vercel); /api/public-admin-claim reads it as the fallback for admin.password.
_notes.commissioner_roles: Per-town passwords live at leagues/etbl.admin.roles.<town> and are written with `npm run set-admin-role -- --league etbl --role <town> --town "<Town>" --scopes scores,volunteers --password ...`, never in this file.
